import { parseOpaqueIdentifier } from "./opaque.js";
import { invalidInput, isOk, ok } from "./parsed.js";
// ---- 不透明标识（S-1 / S-2 / S-3 / S-9） ----
/** 本模块的三个身份品牌，供消费者的静态检查引用；登录标识和交接凭证不是身份。 */
export const IDENTITY_BRAND_NAMES = Object.freeze([
    'AccountId',
    'OrganizationId',
    'LoginStateId',
]);
/** 身份值类型包含三个品牌及两个结构身份（S-5、S-11）；不包含角色或成员效力。 */
export const IDENTITY_TYPE_NAMES = Object.freeze([
    ...IDENTITY_BRAND_NAMES,
    'TenantId',
    'ScopeLayerIdentity',
]);
export const parseAccountId = (value) => parseOpaqueIdentifier(value, 'AccountId');
export const parseOrganizationId = (value) => parseOpaqueIdentifier(value, 'OrganizationId');
export const parseLoginStateId = (value) => parseOpaqueIdentifier(value, 'LoginStateId');
export const parseLoginIdentifier = (value) => parseOpaqueIdentifier(value, 'LoginIdentifier');
// ---- 封闭枚举（S-4 / S-8 / S-32） ----
export const ORGANIZATION_KINDS = ['personal', 'team'];
export const TENANT_ROLES = ['superAdministrator', 'member'];
function parseEnum(value, members, name) {
    if (typeof value !== 'string')
        return invalidInput(`${name}: not a string`);
    // S-32：未知取值一律拒绝，不映射到「最接近」的已知值。
    return members.includes(value)
        ? ok(value)
        : invalidInput(`${name}: unknown value`);
}
export const parseOrganizationKind = (value) => parseEnum(value, ORGANIZATION_KINDS, 'OrganizationKind');
export const parseTenantRole = (value) => parseEnum(value, TENANT_ROLES, 'TenantRole');
function isPlainObject(value) {
    return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}
function hasOnlyKeys(value, keys) {
    return Object.keys(value).every(key => keys.includes(key));
}
/** 两个分量均必需（S-12），不得用环境值补齐；多余成员一律拒绝（S-7）。 */
export function parseTenantId(value) {
    if (!isPlainObject(value))
        return invalidInput('TenantId: not an object');
    if (!hasOnlyKeys(value, ['organization', 'account'])) {
        return invalidInput('TenantId: unexpected member');
    }
    const organization = parseOrganizationId(value['organization']);
    if (!isOk(organization))
        return invalidInput(`TenantId.organization: ${organization.invalidInput}`);
    const account = parseAccountId(value['account']);
    if (!isOk(account))
        return invalidInput(`TenantId.account: ${account.invalidInput}`);
    return ok({ organization: organization.ok, account: account.ok });
}
/** 相等按分量（S-5），不存在第三种相等依据。 */
export function tenantIdEquals(a, b) {
    return a.organization === b.organization && a.account === b.account;
}
/**
 * S-7 的唯一规范序列化形式：两个成员、固定键序、无多余成员。
 * 这是交换表示，不是标量键——本版不给标量键（G-05）。
 */
export function toCanonicalJson(tenant) {
    return JSON.stringify({ organization: tenant.organization, account: tenant.account });
}
export function parseMembershipStanding(value) {
    if (!isPlainObject(value))
        return invalidInput('MembershipStanding: not an object');
    const standing = value['standing'];
    if (standing === 'effective') {
        if (!hasOnlyKeys(value, ['standing', 'role'])) {
            return invalidInput('MembershipStanding: unexpected member');
        }
        const role = parseTenantRole(value['role']);
        if (!isOk(role))
            return invalidInput('MembershipStanding: effective requires a role');
        return ok({ standing: 'effective', role: role.ok });
    }
    if (standing === 'ineffective') {
        if (!hasOnlyKeys(value, ['standing'])) {
            return invalidInput('MembershipStanding: ineffective carries no role');
        }
        return ok({ standing: 'ineffective' });
    }
    return invalidInput('MembershipStanding: unknown standing');
}
export function parseMembershipStandingResult(value) {
    if (isPlainObject(value) && 'failure' in value) {
        if (value['failure'] === 'unavailable' && hasOnlyKeys(value, ['failure'])) {
            return ok({ failure: 'unavailable' });
        }
        return invalidInput('MembershipStandingResult: unknown failure shape');
    }
    return parseMembershipStanding(value);
}
export function parseScopeLayerIdentity(value) {
    if (!isPlainObject(value))
        return invalidInput('ScopeLayerIdentity: not an object');
    const layer = value['layer'];
    if (layer === 'organization') {
        if (!hasOnlyKeys(value, ['layer', 'organization'])) {
            return invalidInput('ScopeLayerIdentity: unexpected member');
        }
        const organization = parseOrganizationId(value['organization']);
        if (!isOk(organization))
            return invalidInput('ScopeLayerIdentity.organization invalid');
        return ok({ layer: 'organization', organization: organization.ok });
    }
    if (layer === 'tenant') {
        if (!hasOnlyKeys(value, ['layer', 'tenant'])) {
            return invalidInput('ScopeLayerIdentity: unexpected member');
        }
        const tenant = parseTenantId(value['tenant']);
        if (!isOk(tenant))
            return invalidInput(`ScopeLayerIdentity.tenant: ${tenant.invalidInput}`);
        return ok({ layer: 'tenant', tenant: tenant.ok });
    }
    return invalidInput('ScopeLayerIdentity: unknown layer');
}
